findings.highlight: Have you taken leave of your senses!?
findings.evidenceJa: 私たちの目を盗んで出かけるとは
findings.governingReading: 私たちの目を盗んで出かける explicitly names evading their observation to leave while ill.
findings.explanation: Going out behind their backs becomes a general question about sanity.

findings.highlight: result in nothing less than Saber calling our contract null and void.
findings.evidenceJa: 本気で契約解除をしかねない
findings.governingReading: 契約解除をしかねない says she might actually terminate it if he explains badly; this is Shirou’s apprehension.
findings.explanation: A feared possibility of contract termination becomes a certain result.
